name: Mount Tammany
where: Worthington State Forest, Delaware Water Gap NRA, NJ
blurb: Three hikes from the Dunnfield Creek lot at the Delaware Water Gap: a creekside walk to a small falls, the steep Red Dot and Blue Dot loop over Mount Tammany, and a loop to Sunfish Pond on the Appalachian Trail.
status: Open: no closures posted by NPS or NJ DEP (Nov 2026); the Dunnfield Creek lot off I-80 fills early on weekends, overflow at Kittatinny Point, no parking on I-80 or road shoulders.

trails.name: Mount Tammany Loop (Red Dot and Blue Dot)
